verdict.rationale: The evidence shows reviewers can accept or reject cases in case management, and that the ML engine uses Adyen's global transaction data. Nothing documents those review decisions or confirmed fraud outcomes feeding back into the model or rules. The Referrals API and risk lists only let users manually push data into block and trust lists, which is a separate control rather than a learning feedback loop.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, my review decisions and confirmed fraud outcomes feed back into the model and rules, so the system learns from every case we work
